jobs.description: Experience in business development, sales or account management, preferably within inspection, laboratory testing, certification, logistics or the metals and minerals sector.The role involves identifying new customers across the Netherlands and Europe, promoting Mitra Netherlands B.V.s inspection and laboratory services, preparing quotations, negotiating commercial terms and maintaining client relationships. The candidate will coordinate with operational and laboratory teams, monitor market opportunities and maintain sales records and forecasts.Strong communication, negotiation and networking skills are required, together with a proactive approach and willingness to travel for client meetings. Good English is essential; Dutch and other European languages are an advantage. An existing network in metals, minerals, coal, coke, ferroalloys or international commodity trading is preferred.We provide inspection, sampling and laboratory analysis services for metals, minerals, coal, coke, ferroalloys and other internationally traded commodities. We are seeking a Business Development Manager who combines commercial skills with an interest in technical services.You will identify new business opportunities, build relationships with customers, visit clients, prepare proposals and negotiate contracts. Working closely with our inspection and laboratory teams, you will help customers find suitable solutions and develop long-term partnerships.We welcome candidates with a science or business administration background and at least two years of sales, marketing or business development experience. Experience in testing, inspection, certification or the commodities sector is an advantage.The role offers varied responsibilities, direct involvement in business growth and opportunities to develop an industry network across Europe.Please apply by email with your CV and a brief cover letter, stating your availability.

Keep people, processes and systems moving as a Warehouse Support Specialist in a brand new Tech warehouse operation in Lelystad. Wie zoeken we? You are curious, analytical and naturally focused on finding solutions. You enjoy figuring out why something is not working and are not afraid to get involved on the warehouse floor. You communicate easily with different colleagues and like combining a practical approach with an interest in systems and data. For this position, you bring: MBO+ or HBO working and thinking level Good command of the English language, both spoken and written Experience with ERP and or WMS systems is a plus, such as SAP Knowledge of warehouse processes such as inbound, outbound and inventory management A structured and process focused approach Wat bieden wij je? You will work in a modern Tech environment where you have plenty of opportunity to develop your skills and grow your career. Your own office is located directly on the warehouse floor, keeping you close to the operation and your colleagues. A gross monthly salary of €2,607 to €3,349 based on a 40 hour working week, depending on experience Company laptop and phone Attractive pension scheme Travel allowance Discounts on gym membership and bike plan, Team events and activities Training, development and career opportunities For this position, you must have the legal right to work in the Netherlands at the time of applying. Functieomschrijving As a Warehouse Support Specialist, you are the link between the daily warehouse operation, systems and processes. You spend a large part of your day on the warehouse floor, so you know what is happening in the operation and can quickly respond when something goes wrong. A process is not working as expected? An order is stuck? Inventory does not match the system? You investigate what is happening, identify the cause and work with the right colleagues to find a solution. As a Warehouse Support Specialist, you will: Act as a first point of contact foroperational and system related questions and issues Investigate discrepancies in orders, inventory and warehouse processes Use ERP and WMS systems to identify and resolve operational issues Analyse operational data and performance using Excel Monitor data quality and ensure information in operational systems is accurate Support root cause analyses and corrective actions Identify bottlenecks and suggest practical process improvements Work closely with Warehouse Operations, Quality, Planning, Customer Support and other stakeholders Contribute to the successful launch and further development of the new Tech operation in Lelystad The position is carried out in a 2 shift operation. You have your own office directly on the warehouse floor, giving you the space to focus when needed while keeping you closely connected to the daily operation. Because the location is new, you will have the opportunity to help shape processes and ways of working from the start. As you develop your knowledge of the operation and systems, there are opportunities to grow further within the organization. Ready to put your analytical skills, system knowledge and problem solving mindset to work? Apply now for the Warehouse Support Specialist position in Lelystad.
